steps: Give your friend the Mt. Rainier CU referral form with your name.
Friend becomes a member of Mt. Rainier CU (live, work, or worship in Washington).
You both receive $25 - no limit on referrals.
timing: No explicit payout window stated on the form.
when_cash_arrives: No explicit payout window stated on the form. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
